exact_committed_completed_node.assessment: Options > tag suggestions opens an explicit owner-held draft with independent ordered search/result namespace tables. Namespace then weight questions append one colon, reject empty/colon catch-alls and duplicate slices, preserve exact warnings, accept 0..10000, allow catch-all weight edits but protect them from deletion, retain selected row identity and enable Edit only for one row. Question/child/parent Cancel discards the corresponding edits; child Apply only stages; parent Apply atomically saves changed weights and preserves live unrelated related preferences. Reopen restores persisted tables. Saved weights reach an already-open local Manage Tags related list, where independent search/result weighting, binary64 truncation, sibling-ideal deduplication, storage/display and local/all-known distinctions match fresh bounded actual Qt cases. Activation only adds missing tags to the captured files. Namespace and numeric-weight headers use Python casefold/full-row tie-breaks in both directions, preserving stable equal keys and selected namespace identity. Each table retains independent selection and sort direction across the native view selector; Add replaces prior selection with the new namespace, matching Qt.

limitations: Namespace/weight questions use inline blocking panes in an Options-owned child rather than Qt modal child frames; warning text is shown inline. Deeper shared dialog/frame hierarchy is not claimed.

Manage Tags currently supports local tag services. Related query computes the full corpus; configurable quick/medium/thorough time budgets, Qt large-population sampling and selected-main-tag search/exclusion mode are not implemented.

Alternate tag-context service, repository Manage Tags and file-lookup script suggestions remain unavailable. Full shared suggested-tabs and default-page families remain Partial; this packet promotes no parent or alias.
Float results beyond recorded integer-truncation and bounded corpus cases, large-corpus top100 tie behavior, cross-status duplicate mappings and timed sampling remain unverified.

Qt displays search and result lists simultaneously; the native shared view selector preserves their separate selection/sort state. Column-width/reordering, cross-owner remembered header preference, and keyboard shift-anchor continuity through resort remain outside this bounded repair.

No committed QtPNG for this group; actual questions/warnings/rank/header traces in related_tag_weights.json/related_weight_table.json support semantic comparison. Native captures must be inspected for legibility.
Qt shows both tables; native uses a shared view selector preserving separate sort/selection. Native questions/warnings are blocking inline panes rather than Qt modal child frames.

Full-corpus local-service query lacks time budgets/Qt large-population sampling, selected-tag exclusion/search modes, repository/alternate service/file-lookup availability. Bounded corpus/binary64 truncation only; large top100 ties/cross-status duplicate maps remain unproved.

Native weight capture is staged Add probe10000 before child Apply; consumer capture is earlier initial ranked list1154/1154/707, not photographed reranking after save. Exact rerank4616/577/353 is a required test assertion.
Linux validation only; Windows/macOS deferred. Broader related-tag search controls, suggestion width/layout/default-page, parents and aliases remain outside this original weights leaf.

No committed Qt weights UI PNG exists: actual Qt namespace questions, sort/header traces and cosine/rank JSON fixtures support semantics; the two fresh native images were inspected for readable controls and visible ranks, without a claim of Qt/native pixel equality.
